subject.title: [Bug]: Slack reaction_added/reaction_removed events never delivered via Socket Mode (multi-account, v2026.3.24)

question: Is the current evidence sufficient to promote an implementation PR for this Slack reaction issue, or should maintainers require live current-main Socket Mode envelopes first?
rationale: Source inspection proves expected handler support and plausible drop boundaries, but not the reported live first-failure point; a repair without live evidence would be guessing between Slack/Bolt delivery, account filtering, and authorization.

options.title: Require live reaction diagnostics
options.body: Keep the issue open until a maintainer or reporter captures redacted current-main reaction_added/reaction_removed envelopes plus gateway trace logs for one multi-account setup.

options.title: Fold into broader Socket Mode triage
options.body: Treat this as part of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/77249 only if live evidence shows all Slack Socket Mode events stall, not just reactions.

options.title: Close after current-main proof
options.body: Close as implemented only if maintainers can produce live current-main proof that reactions arrive and route correctly in the reported multi-account shape.

recommendation.title: Require live reaction diagnostics
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open until a maintainer or reporter captures redacted current-main reaction_added/reaction_removed envelopes plus gateway trace logs for one multi-account setup.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history trail for the Slack mismatch/filter boundary and central monitor files points to steipete, with vincentkoc owning the related routing fix.
